const raw=await fs.readFile('migrations/0003_sleeve_size_validation.sql','utf8'),normalized=raw.replaceAll('\r\n','\n');const schemas=[];for(const sql of [raw,normalized]){const local=await isolatedNotBggD1();try{await migrateIsolatedD1(local.db,'0002_normalize_sleeve_sizes.sql');await local.db.batch(migrationStatements(sql).map(x=>local.db.prepare(x)));const schema=(await local.db.prepare("SELECT name,sql FROM sqlite_schema WHERE type='trigger' AND name LIKE 'trg_sleeve_sizes_validate_%' ORDER BY name").all()).results;schemas.push(schema);await local.db.prepare('INSERT INTO sleeve_sizes(width_tenth_mm,height_tenth_mm) VALUES(100,200)').run();await assert.rejects(local.db.prepare('INSERT INTO sleeve_sizes(width_tenth_mm,height_tenth_mm) VALUES(700,600)').run(),/short side first/);await assert.rejects(local.db.prepare('UPDATE sleeve_sizes SET width_tenth_mm=700,height_tenth_mm=600 WHERE width_tenth_mm=100').run(),/short side first/);}finally{await local.dispose();}}assert.deepEqual(schemas[0],schemas[1]);await fs.writeFile('docs/d7a-r6-0003-verification.json',JSON.stringify({status:'PASS',mode:'isolated synthetic D1; raw R4 worktree vs prospective LF Git Blob',triggerSchemaEqual:true,triggerCount:schemas[0].length,validInsert:true,invalidInsertRejected:true,invalidUpdateRejected:true,sourceModified:false,indexModified:false,limit:'Verifies 0003 normalized SQL behavior; not a full committed clean-checkout release build'},null,2));console.log('0003_RAW_AND_EXPECTED_BLOB_PASS');
